attributes.name: cohesionBroken
attributes.description: is cohesion active? will be set false when a fragile contact is broken

attributes.name: isBroken
attributes.description: true if compression plastic fracture achieved

attributes.name: unp
attributes.description: plastic normal penetration depth describing the equilibrium state.

attributes.name: twp
attributes.description: plastic twist penetration depth describing the equilibrium state.

attributes.name: onPlastB
attributes.description: true if plasticity achieved on bending

attributes.name: onPlastTw
attributes.description: true if plasticity achieved on twisting

attributes.name: onPlastT
attributes.description: true if plasticity achieved on traction

attributes.name: onPlastC
attributes.description: true if plasticity achieved on compression

attributes.name: maxCrpRchdT
attributes.description: maximal extension reached on plastic deformation. maxCrpRchdT[0] stores un and maxCrpRchdT[1] stores Fn.

attributes.name: maxCrpRchdC
attributes.description: maximal compression reached on plastic deformation. maxCrpRchdC[0] stores un and maxCrpRchdC[1] stores Fn.

attributes.name: maxCrpRchdTw
attributes.description: maximal twist reached on plastic deformation. maxCrpRchdTw[0] stores twist angle and maxCrpRchdTw[1] stores twist moment.

attributes.name: maxCrpRchdB
attributes.description: maximal bending moment reached on plastic deformation.

attributes.name: pureCreep
attributes.description: Pure creep curve, used for comparison in calculation.

attributes.name: kDam
attributes.description: Damage coefficient on bending, computed from maximum bending moment reached and pure creep behaviour. Its values will vary between

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only Law2_ScGeom_FrictPhys_CundallStrack) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
